drill: Select a bar, cell or dot to open the products behind it.

kpi.age: {days, plural, =0 {collected today} one {# day old} other {# days old}}

ladder.title: Price ladder by category
ladder.question: Where entry, mid and premium prices sit in each category.
ladder.legend: Entry is the cheapest quarter, mid the middle half, premium the top quarter. Log scale.
ladder.label: Price ranges by category, {n} categories.

promo.title: Promotion depth
promo.question: How many discounted products each category has, by depth of discount.
promo.label: Discounted products by category and discount band.

brands.title: Brand price positioning
brands.question: Median price of the {n} brands with the most products.
brands.label: Median price per brand, {n} brands, highest first.

mix.title: Category mix
mix.question: Products per category; area is the count.
mix.label: Products per category, {n} top-level categories.

hist.title: Price distribution
hist.question: How many products sit in each price band.
hist.label: Products per price band, {n} bands.

rating.title: Rating vs price
rating.question: Whether pricier products rate higher. Dot size is the number of reviews.
rating.note: {rated} of {n} products carry a rating; {k} shown.
rating.none: The retailer shows no ratings in this snapshot.
rating.label: Rating against price, {k} products.

top.title: Top discounts
top.question: The deepest markdowns in this snapshot.

share.title: Brand concentration
share.question: How much of the catalogue the largest brands hold.
share.headline: The top {k} brands hold {share} of all products.
share.label: Share of products per brand, {n} largest brands.

pairs: {n, plural, one {# comparable pair} other {# comparable pairs}}
matchedOnly: Matched products only, not the full catalogues.

index.title: Price index over time
index.question: {other}'s basket against {base}'s, day by day. 100 is parity; above it {other} is dearer.
index.noHistory: History begins once nightly collection runs.
index.label: Price index per collection day, {n} days.

gaps.title: Biggest price gaps
gaps.question: The matched products whose prices sit furthest apart. Select a bar to open the product.
gaps.label: Price gap per matched product, {n} widest.

cheaper.title: Who's cheaper by category
cheaper.question: How many matched pairs each retailer wins in every category.
cheaper.thin: {n, plural, one {# category has} other {# categories have}} too few pairs to count: {list}.
cheaper.label: Pairs won per retailer per category, {n} categories.

groupGap.title: Price gap by brand
groupGap.question: Median gap of the matched pairs in each {by}; positive means {other} is dearer.
groupGap.label: Median price gap per group, {n} groups.

cross.title: Who's cheaper by category and brand
cross.question: On every matched pair in a category and brand, how often each retailer is cheaper. Select a cell to open those pairs.
cross.label: Who is cheaper per category and brand, {rows} categories by {cols} brands.
cross.thinNote: {n, plural, one {# cell has} other {# cells have}} fewer than {min} pairs and read as too few, never as a result.
cross.truncated: The matched list is longer than one response carries, so the grid is not drawn; the shares below come from the server's groups.

cheaperShare.title: Cheaper share by {by}
cheaperShare.question: Of each {by}'s matched pairs, the share where each retailer is cheaper. Select a bar to open the comparison.
cheaperShare.label: Share of pairs won per retailer per {by}, {n} groups.
cheaperShare.thin: {n, plural, one {# group has} other {# groups have}} too few pairs to count: {list}.

nPairs: n = {n, plural, one {# comparable pair} other {# comparable pairs}}
